lines.1: 「In the overall midterm results, our Class 2-C placed fourth among the seven second-year classes. A respectable performance.」
lines.2: 「However, we failed to surpass our sworn enemy, Class 2-A.」
lines.3: 「I am sure none of you enjoy hearing that this is a one-woman class carried by Kiriya. Let us aim to improve our rank on the final exams.」
lines.4: 「Mr. Tsuchinaga has a few words for you.」
lines.5: 「Listen. Tests are just symbols on paper. Not much of what they cover passes for knowledge you need to survive.」
lines.6: 「But if you work hard and get good scores, you get more options for your future. It's a stupid system, but that's how Japan works. So do your best.」
lines.8: 「Remember: those were not my words. A parrot merely squawked them.」
